blurb: Guests take cruises on Canyon Lake aboard the Dolly Steamboat to see desert bighorn sheep, bald eagles, and other wildlife. Cruises include scenic nature tours, twilight dinner cruises, astronomy dinner cruises, and special bighorn sheep viewing events. The boat has air conditioned lower and upper decks and offers narration about the Superstition Mountains.

quotes.author: Tomfolwell
quotes.text: We had friends from out of town and we thought they should see part of the Superstition Mountains and look at them from the lake. Great afternoon and well worth the money.

quotes.author: PhyllieG
quotes.text: Great for all ages. Reasonably priced Favorite for those who like water in the desert The guide is very engaging. A stop for out of towners

quotes.author: Compass56
quotes.text: What a wonderful day trip! We absolutely loved our excursion on the Dolly Steamboat. The staff is delightful. Would thoroughly recommend!

quotes.author: Budv
quotes.text: This was a great boat ride. The cost was $25.00 for a 90-minute tour. Very interesting and the staff was very friendly.

quotes.author: Cskoda2
quotes.text: A very pleasant way to see the sites. A definite must do on your trip. We will try the sunset cruise next time!
A great way to see beautiful rock formations, wildlife, and a gorgeous lake. A must do on any adventure.
